why: Task 5.3 guard table for contracts/compliance/: one row per guard site, checked by scripts/ci/guards-table.js (its header says what each class means and what is checked).

sites.site: ComplianceRulesAdmin.setGovernanceToken | token == address(0) | InvalidTokenAddress
sites.test: is recorded once, by the owner, never the zero address

sites.site: ComplianceRulesAdmin.setGovernanceToken | governanceToken != address(0) | GovernanceTokenAlreadySet
sites.test: is recorded once, by the owner, never the zero address

sites.site: ComplianceRulesAdmin.setGovernanceToken | whitelistMode[token] != WhitelistMode.OracleOnly || whitelistOracle[token] != address(0) | GovernanceTokenWhitelist
sites.test: refuses a token that already has a ZK mode or a whitelist oracle

sites.site: ComplianceRulesAdmin.setBlacklistOracle | token == address(0) | InvalidTokenAddress
sites.test: the setters refuse the zero token and an oracle with no code

sites.site: ComplianceRulesAdmin.setBlacklistOracle | oracle != address(0) && oracle.code.length == 0 | OracleNotAContract
sites.test: the setters refuse the zero token and an oracle with no code

sites.site: ComplianceRulesAdmin.setBlacklistOracle | !ok || ret.length != 32 | OracleIncompatible
sites.test: rejects a contract that does not answer the oracle selector

sites.site: ComplianceRulesAdmin.setWhitelistOracle | token == address(0) | InvalidTokenAddress
sites.test: the setters refuse the zero token and an oracle with no code

sites.site: ComplianceRulesAdmin.setWhitelistOracle | oracle != address(0) && oracle.code.length == 0 | OracleNotAContract
sites.test: the setters refuse the zero token and an oracle with no code

sites.site: ComplianceRulesAdmin.setWhitelistOracle | oracle != address(0) && token == governanceToken | GovernanceTokenWhitelist
sites.test: then refuses ZkOnly, Either and a whitelist oracle for it only

sites.site: ComplianceRulesAdmin.setWhitelistOracle | !ok || ret.length < 64 | OracleIncompatible
sites.test: rejects a contract that does not answer the oracle selector

sites.site: ComplianceRulesAdmin.setWhitelistOracle | live > 1 || tier > type(uint8).max | OracleIncompatible
sites.test: refuses a bool word of 2, a tier word above 255 and a short return

sites.site: ComplianceRulesAdmin.setPrivacyManager | token == address(0) | InvalidTokenAddress
sites.test: the setters refuse the zero token and an oracle with no code

sites.site: ComplianceRulesAdmin.setPrivacyManager | whitelistMode[token] != WhitelistMode.OracleOnly | PrivacyManagerInUse
sites.test: ZkOnly/Either need a PrivacyManager; it cannot be cleared while used

sites.site: ComplianceRulesAdmin.setPrivacyManager | pm.code.length == 0 | PrivacyManagerNotAContract
sites.test: refuses a non-contract or incompatible PrivacyManager, token 0, a bad mode

sites.site: ComplianceRulesAdmin.setPrivacyManager | !ok || ret.length != 32 | PrivacyManagerIncompatible
sites.test: refuses a non-contract or incompatible PrivacyManager, token 0, a bad mode

sites.site: ComplianceRulesAdmin.setWhitelistMode | token == address(0) | InvalidTokenAddress
sites.test: the setters refuse the zero token and an oracle with no code

sites.site: ComplianceRulesAdmin.setWhitelistMode | mode != WhitelistMode.OracleOnly && token == governanceToken | GovernanceTokenWhitelist
sites.test: then refuses ZkOnly, Either and a whitelist oracle for it only

sites.site: ComplianceRulesAdmin.setWhitelistMode | mode != WhitelistMode.OracleOnly && privacyManager[token] == address(0) | PrivacyManagerNotSet
sites.test: ZkOnly and Either need a PrivacyManager: PrivacyManagerNotSet (173)

sites.site: ComplianceRulesAdmin.modifier onlyGovernance | ruleAdministrators[token][msg.sender] | ComplianceRules: Only governance can update rules
sites.test: grants no rule administrator at construction (G5)

sites.site: ComplianceRulesAdmin.setTokenIdentityRegistry | token != address(0) | ComplianceRules: Invalid token address
sites.test: setTokenIdentityRegistry is the owner's and refuses zero on both sides (N03)

sites.site: ComplianceRulesAdmin.setTokenIdentityRegistry | identityRegistry != address(0) | ComplianceRules: Invalid identity registry address
sites.test: setTokenIdentityRegistry is the owner's and refuses zero on both sides (N03)

sites.site: ComplianceRulesAdmin.setTokenIdentityRegistry | identityRegistry.code.length > 0 | ComplianceRules: registry is not a contract
sites.test: rejects binding an EOA as the identity registry

sites.site: ComplianceRulesAdmin.setRuleAdministrator | token != address(0) | ComplianceRules: Invalid token address
sites.test: Should reject zero address for token

sites.site: ComplianceRulesAdmin.setRuleAdministrator | administrator != address(0) | ComplianceRules: Invalid administrator address
sites.test: Should reject zero address for administrator

sites.site: ComplianceRulesAdmin.setJurisdictionRule | allowedCountries.length <= MAX_COUNTRIES | ComplianceRules: Too many allowed countries
sites.test: Should reject setting too many countries

sites.site: ComplianceRulesAdmin.setJurisdictionRule | blockedCountries.length <= MAX_COUNTRIES | ComplianceRules: Too many blocked countries
sites.test: Should reject too many blocked countries

sites.site: ComplianceRulesTrust.setTrustedRegistrar | token != address(0) | ComplianceRules: Invalid token address
sites.test: setTrustedRegistrar: owner only, a contract, not a delegated wallet

sites.site: ComplianceRulesTrust.setTrustedRegistrar | registrar != address(0) | Invalid address
sites.test: setTrustedRegistrar: owner only, a contract, not a delegated wallet

sites.site: ComplianceRulesTrust.addTrustedContract | allowed != bytes32(0) | ComplianceRules: not owner or registrar
sites.test: a registrar trusts an account with the registered code, not another

sites.site: ComplianceRulesTrust.addTrustedContract | contractAddress.codehash == allowed | ComplianceRules: code not registered
sites.test: a registrar trusts an account with the registered code, not another

sites.site: ComplianceRulesTrust.addTrustedContract | token != address(0) | ComplianceRules: Invalid token address
sites.test: refuses the zero token; the owner stays trusted on every token (D21)

sites.site: ComplianceRulesTrust.addTrustedContract | contractAddress != address(0) | Invalid address
sites.test: ComplianceRules.addTrustedContract refuses the zero contract

sites.site: ComplianceRulesTrust.addTrustedContract | !trustedContracts[token][contractAddress] | Already trusted
sites.test: a registrar trusts an account with the registered code, not another

sites.site: ComplianceRulesTrust.removeTrustedContract | trustedContracts[token][contractAddress] | Not trusted
sites.test: trust on one token is not trust on another; events name the token

sites.site: ComplianceRulesTrust.removeTrustedContract | contractAddress != owner() | ComplianceRules: owner stays trusted
sites.test: refuses the zero token; the owner stays trusted on every token (D21)

sites.site: ComplianceRulesTrust._requireContract | account.code.length > 0 | ComplianceRules: not a contract
sites.test: refuses a wallet

sites.site: ComplianceRulesTrust._requireContract | !(code[0] == 0xef && code[1] == 0x01 && code[2] == 0x00) | ComplianceRules: delegated wallet
sites.test: refuses a wallet carrying an EIP-7702 delegation
